hypothesis: H74's bounded current-state torque request can be retained while nonzero native stiffness and damping make Rapier respond implicitly to coordinate and velocity changes during every solver substep.

physical.startup: Opt-in h77-v1 selection on the unmodified 25-body dynamic assembly; normal room and playground startup remain legacy until every acceptance stage passes.

controller.rationale: Retain H74's coordinated bounded request and anatomical axis caps. Configure Rapier with the real reference, nonzero kp, and existing kd; encode only request minus kp times error plus kd times rate as residual feedforward.

heldOut.rationale: Separate uncalibrated headings and physical body/hand disturbances may invoke bounded rescue steps. Acceptance still requires qualified double-support touchdown, a new stance revision, and return to standing.

rollout.promotionRule: Promote only after every acceptance stage, including actual-browser runtime and process-memory gates, passes.
